name: Reasoning models via BYOM
summary: BYOM-routed o3 / o4-mini call with reasoning_effort and max_completion_tokens forwarded.
description: Validates that APIM policies forward the reasoning-model-specific parameters (`reasoning_effort`, `max_completion_tokens`). Some APIM policies strip unknown query/body fields, breaking reasoning models silently.
notes: Skips if REASONING_MODEL env var is not set.
